verdict.rationale: Mintlify's web editor lets non-technical users edit pages, use an AI agent, preview changes, and merge PRs without leaving the editor, so changes land in the same git-backed source of truth (mintlify-docs-1, mintlify-docs-12, mintlify-docs-13, mintlify-docs-25, mintlify-docs-26). This directly matches the story of visual editing that flows into the same source of truth. missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation from a non-technical user's perspective (community evidence focuses on security/pricing, not editor UX), and no detail on conflict handling when git and editor changes overlap.
